4/ Smart Diagnostics 🔬🤖

Recently developed AI-powered PCR testing has a minute-time threshold to determine HMPV, with its primary goal being efficiency for the patients in terms of wait time and accuracy of test results.

5/ Wearables & Remote Monitoring ⌚📱

Certain devices monitor vital statistics like the oxygen level of patients in a high-risk category along with their respiratory rate. Any potential threats are notified to the caregivers immediately.
